description.en: A credit & debit card component for payment forms: live brand detection, 3D flip, themeable variants. Zero dependencies — React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS.
description.zh: 极具质感的支付表单银行卡交互组件：支持实时卡组织识别、3D 真实翻转、丰富卡面材质。零外部依赖，统一支持 React/Vue/Svelte/原生 JS。

content.en: crd-ui provides a hyper-polished credit and debit card interface designed for high-converting checkout flows. As the user enters details into regular payment fields, the card mirrors the input in real-time, displays live brand badges (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, JCB, UnionPay, and more), and realistically flips to the back when focusing the CVV/CVC field. Shipped with zero external dependencies and weighing under 10KB, it provides official bindings for React, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla HTML.
content.zh: crd-ui 是一套专为高转化支付结账页打造的逼真 3D 信用卡输入组件。当用户在表单中输入卡号时，卡面会自适应进行 4 位分段格式化，并在毫秒级内自动匹配识别 Visa、Mastercard、Amex、JCB、银联等主流卡组织标志；光标聚焦至安全码输入框时，卡片将触发平滑真实的 3D 翻转翻至背面。纯 CSS 3D 硬件加速，零第三方依赖，打包体积小于 10KB。

components: Brand Detection (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, JCB, UnionPay, Discover)
